notes: The manual is pictures only, so the exact stud positions are my best reading. The set of connected pieces and the hinge joints are more reliable than the specific port numbers.
All 32 pieces from the parts list appear once, as b1 to b32 in build order.

The six red 44302a hinges and six black 44301a hinges form six hinged legs. Two of the black hinges (b19, b20) carry the black 2x4 plates (b25, b26) as claws. That is my reading of the step 7 picture.

The dark bluish gray 44302a (b2) and the 44567a (b27) are joined by a hinge. This is where the step 8 sub-assembly attaches. The sub-assembly is the red 1x2, black 2x3 and three orange 1x2 plates on b27.
The lever pieces (b13, b14) have no anti-stud ports in the catalogue, so I connected their studs upward into the anti-studs on the underside of the 4x4 plate.
The sub-assembly in step 8 is only built once, so there is no repeat group.
